justification: The strongest specific correspondence is the use of shallow relief on an upright stone surface with profile animal/bird-like motifs and a circular disc arranged around a horizontal band. The biggest difference is that A is a rounded anthropomorphic figure with sparse, worn decoration integrated into a body-like form, while B is a flat rectangular slab with denser, more compartmentalized registers of carving.
